_comment: item 2 before-state, pass A (xcuitest only; the idb step is removed on this branch). fresh install, no fmxFirstRunDone.

pass A: first run steps 1-3 as a customer sees them (not signed in), the Apple ID sign-in sheet step 3 opens, then a relaunch with -fmxFirstRunDone YES for the switches tab, the whole Settings tab and the screen Upgrade to Pro opens.
pass B (plan-signed-in.json) and pass C (plan-helper.json) run after it on the same install; see sim-harness.yml.
points, not pixels (an iPhone 17 Pro is 402 x 874 points). dy > 0 moves the finger UP by dy points, which scrolls the content down the page.
launch        {args?: [..], waitFor: label, waitType?: 'tab'|'button', timeout?: s}  (re)launch the app and wait for a label
activate      {waitFor?: label, timeout?: s}  bring the Hub back to the front without relaunching it
dismissAlerts {tap?: ['Allow','OK'], seconds?: s}   tap a system alert (the notification question) if one is up
expectAbsent  {label, seconds?, orRelaunchWith?: [..], waitFor?, waitType?}  if the label shows up, note it and optionally relaunch with arguments
shot          {name}          a screenshot plus an accessibility dump, named <name>.png and <name>.tree.*
drag          {dy, x?: 8, hold?: 0.8}  one slow finger drag starting in the left gutter (x=8), so it never lands on a switch
tap           {label, match?: 'exact'|'prefix'|'contains', type?: 'tab'|'button', anywhere?: false, scrollDy?: 300, maxScrolls?: 0, tabIndex?, tabCount?: 3, tabFromBottom?: 58}
anywhere: true taps an element even within 110pt of the top or 95pt of the bottom (the first run's big button sits at y 758-816; navigation bar Close/Done at the top)
back          {}              the navigation bar's back button
